replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body: It might not seem like much, but there is enough iron for 35 full sets of armor. The kits would probably be like most maps, won't be any surprises. The lane does seem long, but I believe it's the same, if not shorter than the one on Rendezvous 3. Changes can be made after testing if it's still a problem.
